cane_weather.rule: Estimated stoppage day: rain of 5 mm or more, the day after 10 mm or more, or the second day after 20 mm or more (daily ERA5 rain at one or more points per state).

scorecard.note: MAPA fortnightly data for all Centre-South mills. Ethanol includes corn ethanol; 'sugar share of ATR' uses all ethanol, so it understates the cane mix as corn ethanol grows; the desk's corn-adjusted mix is shown for this season only.

assumptions: Each fortnight to 31 March: last fortnight's crush × the median path of past seasons from the same date (MAPA, 2014/15 on).
Adjusted by rain: estimated stoppage days in that fortnight above or below the 2011–2025 normal for the same dates reduce or add to the crush, at the rate seen in past fortnights.

Stoppage days: observed to the latest ERA5 day, then the ensemble forecast (10th / 50th / 90th percentile member for dry / base / wet), then 2011–2025 climatology to 31 December (20th / 50th / 80th percentile); January–March at normal.
Sugar per tonne of the remaining cane = last fortnight's kg/t × the median ratio of later-season to same-fortnight kg/t in past seasons (mix and ATR both fall late in the season).
Mills' end dates follow past seasons; if more mills stop early than usual the outcome falls below the wet case.

fuel_policy.detail: Federal tax on gasoline cut by R$0.63/l (total federal tax left R$0.16/l); hydrous ethanol PIS/Cofins zeroed (R$0.19/l). Replaced a R$0.44/l gasoline subsidy that ended 9 Sep.
fuel_policy.effect_on_ethanol_parity: Lower gasoline pump price caps what hydrous can charge at the pump (70% rule); the ethanol tax cut offsets part of it

fuel_policy.detail: Gasoline federal tax cut raised from R$0.63 to R$0.89/l (PIS/Pasep, Cofins and Cide at zero); hydrous ethanol tax cut kept at R$0.19/l; subsidy to ethanol producers raised from R$0.25 to R$0.43/l.
fuel_policy.effect_on_ethanol_parity: The producer subsidy adds to mill ethanol revenue: about 2¢/lb sugar-equivalent at R$0.43/l

fuel_policy.detail: PIS/Pasep and Cofins stay at zero on gasoline (Cide also zero) and on hydrous ethanol; extraordinary subsidy of R$0.428 per litre of hydrous ethanol to producers and co-operatives, to 9 December 2026.
fuel_policy.effect_on_ethanol_parity: Lapse on 9 Dec would lift gasoline by the R$0.89/l of tax and take the R$0.428/l subsidy away from mills: watch for a further extension
